command_templates.name: analyze_hive
command_templates.when: When analyzing a single registry hive.

usage_description: ShellBags Explorer is used to analyze Windows ShellBag artifacts from the registry, providing detailed information about directory structures and user interactions with files and folders.

suspicious_indicators.pattern: Accessed directories that are unusual for the context of the investigation.
suspicious_indicators.description: Indicates potential unauthorized access or activity.

suspicious_indicators.pattern: First Explored and Last Explored times do not match expected usage patterns.
suspicious_indicators.description: May indicate unusual user behavior or hidden activities.
